lines.text: David defeated the Philistines and took Gath and its villages, and he also defeated the Moabites, who brought him tribute.
David defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah as far as Hamath and kept a hundred horses for the chariots.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus and placed garrisons there, because the LORD made him victorious wherever he went.
David brought the gold shields of Hadadezer's officers to Hebron, and from Tibhath and Cun he took bronze that Solomon later used.
Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and placed garrisons in Edom.
